en.headline: Inter-Island Festival returns for third edition across outlying islands
en.dek: The month-long event under the theme ArchipelaGO!GO! runs from 1 to 29 November on Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Mui Wo and Chi Ma Wan, with workshops, tours and exhibitions.
body: The Inter-Island Festival has begun its third edition, running from 1 to 29 November across Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Mui Wo and Chi Ma Wan. Organisers say the event, inspired by the inter-island ferry connections, aims to celebrate the cultures of Hong Kong’s southwestern coastal communities.

This year’s theme is ArchipelaGO!GO!, or 群島共生 in Chinese. The organisers describe it as a way to examine how the islands link as an archipelago through ferry routes, tides, folklore and shared traditions, rather than treating them only as the city’s edges. Previous editions in 2021 and 2023 involved more than 50 collaborators and drew thousands of visitors.

The programme includes workshops, guided tours, exhibitions and performances, with different islands in focus on successive weekends. Details of individual events are listed on the festival’s website. The festival is supported by partners including Design Trust.

zh.headline: 第三屆船到橋頭生活節展開 以群島共生串連離島
zh.dek: 活動由11月1日至29日在長洲、坪洲、梅窩及芝麻灣舉行，包括工作坊、導賞及展覽。
body: 第三屆船到橋頭生活節已展開，由11月1日至29日在長洲、坪洲、梅窩及芝麻灣舉行。主辦方表示，活動以橫水渡航線為靈感，希望延續香港西南沿海的島嶼文化。
本屆主題為「群島共生」（ArchipelaGO!GO!）。主辦方指，希望公眾以群島而非城市邊緣的角度看待這些島嶼，探討渡輪、潮汐、民間傳說及傳統如何將四地連結。2021年及2023年兩屆曾有逾50名合作者參與，吸引數千人到訪。
節目包括工作坊、導賞團、展覽及表演，連續週末會聚焦不同島嶼。個別活動詳情可參閱生活節網站。活動獲信言設計大使等支持。
